finding_summary: The real sum-normalized bounded-Lipschitz dual norm on every finite positive-length vertex star for every signed atomic measure equals an explicit maximum over the positive/negative arm-length knot grid, and has an exact O(m log m) arithmetic evaluation algorithm.

integrity.independent_verification: No independent scientific validation has been performed.
integrity.proof: Self-contained finite-knot identity and piecewise-affine root derivation in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: Only finite vertex metric stars and real-valued tests are treated.
Arbitrary real positive arm lengths are admitted, but total bit complexity is not specified.
Unindexed equivalent algebraic formulations cannot be ruled out by a finite literature search.
Finite program checks do not replace the analytic proof.
title: Exact Dudley dual norms on heterogeneous metric stars
